---
title: "Papers"
---

These pages reproduce the analyses of published soundscape papers with soundscapy.

Each reproduction downloads the version of the International Soundscape Database (ISD)
that its paper used, so the numbers match the paper: the 2022 paper used ISD v0.2.3.
That download needs the network, so the pages are frozen: the site shows the results
stored in `docs/_freeze/` and an ordinary docs build does not re-run them. A nightly job
re-runs every reproduction and reports any change in its results.
